query_syntax.encoding: Repeated URL keys, not a comma-separated value.  Child links in the current UI preserve existing ConceptID keys and append another key.
query_syntax.server_readback: The rendered title uses [Wiley Subject Code: <label>] and the applied facet chip uses the display label.
query_syntax.combination: multiple ConceptID values render as AND selections
query_syntax.raw_query_relation: ConceptID is not text1/text2/text3 grammar and is not a Boolean term inside a Context Search row.
query_syntax.adapter_boundary: The typed --subject-selection contract emits one repeated ConceptID clause per explicitly supplied node and preserves the full supplied ID/label path.  Legacy --subject-id remains ID-only.  The adapter does not guess missing ancestors, comma-pack IDs, or claim explosion.
